name: Squeak
subtitle: Your coding agents, in your pocket

apps.name: Squeak
apps.subtitle: Answer your agents from anywhere
apps.localizedDescription: See every coding agent running on your Mac, read what it said, and answer its questions. Pairs with Squeak for Mac; replies are end-to-end encrypted and signed by this phone's Secure Enclave.
apps.versionDescription: Conductor chats are marked with a plain connection symbol instead of Conductor's app icon.

versions.localizedDescription: Conductor chats are marked with a plain connection symbol instead of Conductor's app icon.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Squeak uses the camera once, to scan the pairing code on your Mac.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Squeak asks for Face ID before it sends anything to your agents.
